title: Parity of a Quartic Polynomial with Only Even Powers
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Determine whether the function g(x) = x^4 + 3x^2 - 1 is even, odd, or neither, and give reasons for your answer.

steps.title: Evaluate g(-x)
steps.explanation: Substitute -x for x in each term of g(x) = x^4 + 3x^2 - 1.
steps.why: Testing for even or odd parity begins by computing g(-x).

steps.title: Simplify the Even Powers
steps.explanation: Because 4 and 2 are even integers, (-x)^4 = x^4 and (-x)^2 = x^2, leaving every term of the polynomial unchanged.
steps.why: Raising a negated variable to an even integer power yields the same result as raising the original variable to that power.

steps.title: Conclude Function Parity
steps.explanation: Since g(-x) = g(x) for all real x, g(x) = x^4 + 3x^2 - 1 is an even function.
steps.why: Every polynomial composed exclusively of even powers of x is an even function.
